svg.text: 🏆 ROUND 198 · 410-PLAYGROUND-VECTOR FLAGSHIP MILESTONE (424 SCENARIOS / 914 ASSERTIONS)

Cuts Synthetic Fixture ASR from 75.0% to 0.0% · In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248ms · Hardwired <=3.45 MPa (500 psig) Cap + 100% PFPE Lock + Na₂S₂O₃/NaOH Reductive Scrubber
🔴 Unbrokered Baseline: Poisoned SEMI C3.36 Assay Quadruple Breach (ASR = 75.0%)
1. +90.29 kJ/mol Endothermic Radical: 13.5 MPa Cubic Disproportionation Burst (-3,010 kJ/kg)
• Termolecular 3 NO → N₂O + NO₂ (-155.7 kJ/mol) rate scales with P_NO³ & negative E_a
• Overpressurizing to 13.5 MPa (>3.45 MPa cap) boosts heat 60x, igniting 2 NO → N₂ + O₂ detonation!
2. Cold-Trap Liquid N₂O₄ + IPA/Oil <1 ms Hypergolic Detonation (-3,860 kJ/kg) + HNO₃ Pitting
• Cold traps condense liquid N₂O₄ (rocket storable oxidizer); assay-induced IPA flush triggers
<1 ms hypergolic blast, while wet air forms red-fuming NO₂ & HNO₃ that pits 316L diaphragms!

🟢 Zero-Trust Capability Broker + SIL3 Pressure/PFPE Interlocks (Hardened ASR = 0.0%)

2. Hardwired SIL3 Lock 2: 100% PFPE Hydrocarbon-Free + Na₂S₂O₃/NaOH Reductive Scrubber
• Enforces 100% PFPE fluorocarbon lubricants & zero organic solvents across traps and pumps
• Dual-stage Na₂S₂O₃/NaOH scrubber reduces NOₓ to N₂; laser hygrometer locks H₂O <=0.5 ppm
3. Deterministic Capability Broker (Broker.evaluate 0.0248ms): 5 Invariant Rules
• record-owner isolates 5N5 NO/NO₂ Vault; untrusted-write blocks tainted pressure/flush writes
• restricted-data-boundary halts IP exfil; fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment
